## Settings Options

### Description
> :warning: **The following only pertains to mobile-web. The Settings options in the Native Apps are controlled within the Apps themselves**

The BasePackage contains a SettingsConfig which gets passed to the mobile-web settings menu to define which options are available there. This is all setup and managed without any thing needing to be done in the game code. However you may need to add additional items into the menu which you can do as described below.

Refer to Scratch to see this in action in a game.

### Basic Usage
To add additional items to the Settings menu you will need to define a function that returns an array of type `IAdditionalSettingsItem[]`. Then pass that function into the `AdditionalSettingsGetter` property of the IEngineConfig used to initialise the BasePackage.

The following item types are available (as defined [here](../src/types.ts)):
`'label-field', 'external-link', 'component-link', 'chat-colour-swatch', 'checkbox', 'multi-checkbox'`

In the below Example a checkbox is added to the 2nd group (sectionId: 2) at the 6th position (index: 5) with the label defined in the strings file settings.PREFERENCES section which does *something* on click.

#### Example
```ts
export function getAdditionalSettings(): IAdditionalSettingsItem[] {
    const additionalSettings: IAdditionalSettingsItem[] = [
        {
            sectionId: 2,
            item: {
                type: 'checkbox',
                name: container.strings.settings.PREFERENCES.NAME_OF_YOUR_THING,
                toggle: 'symbolAnimations',
                onClick: (val: boolean) => {
                    // Do something on click
                    // Like emit an event - eventEmitter.emit(scratchEvents.SOME_EVENT);
                    // Or update a preference - userPreferences.updateGamePref('somePreference', !val);
                }
            },
            index: 5
        }
    ];

    return additionalSettings;
}
```
